system.description:
Grants the ability to lift and maneouevre things remotely with one’s mind.

  • Level 1: Lift/Move up to 1 kg
  • Level 2: Lift/Move up to 5 kg
  • Level 3: Lift/Move up to 10 kg
  • Level 4: Lift/Move up to 50 kg
  • Level 5: Lift/Move up to 100 kg
  • Level 6: Lift/Move up to 500 kg
